problem_type: Composer placement ignores shared bottom docks
symptom: After adding an image to the real timeline the mini preview covers the regenerate button.
direct_cause: Composer placement and observation query only the collapsed timeline handle, ignoring data-canvas-bottom-dock overlays.
class_root: Overlay avoidance enumerates one old caller rather than the existing shared obstacle contract.
affected_population: Selected generated nodes with timeline preview or other bottom docks
internal_only_reason: Internal Electron event and generation lifecycle; no third-party contract or new dependency.
invariants: Composer measures and observes all bottom docks in its workspace.
generality_proof: The existing data-canvas-bottom-dock marker identifies both current and future fixed obstacles; no preview-specific branch.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Measure all workspace bottom docks and recompute on membership/size changes.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both expanded and collapsed preview expose data-canvas-bottom-dock.
Batch dock exposes the same marker.

recurrence.reason: Any additional fixed bottom dock could obscure the composer.
same_class_scan: Read TimelineMiniPreview.tsx and CanvasBatchGenerateDock.tsx; both use data-canvas-bottom-dock.
Read useComposerViewportPlacement; only timeline handle was measured and observed.

prevention.invariant: All tagged bottom docks participate in geometry and observer lifecycle.
prevention.failure_mode: The existing viewport pan/flip/height algorithm resolves constrained space instead of hiding controls.
prevention.strategy: Replace single-handle observer with shared-marker obstacle membership and size observation.

legacy_paths.rationale: Single timeline handle discovery/observer replaced; no parallel placement system.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Electron IPC and runtime; no package change.

residual_risks: Future fixed bottom overlays must use the existing data-canvas-bottom-dock contract to participate in avoidance.

invariant_owner_layer.note: Real App regeneration click after mini preview opens, plus queue and scaled viewport interaction.
